outgoing.name: Oxygen
outgoing.section: Planetary environment and the oxygen catastrophe
outgoing.excerpt: The atmosphere of the early Earth is poorly known, but it is thought to have been smothered in reducing gases, containing very little free oxygen.

outgoing.name: Photosynthesis
outgoing.section: Planetary environment and the oxygen catastrophe
outgoing.excerpt: When evolving life forms developed photosynthesis, oxygen began to be produced in large quantities, causing an ecological crisis sometimes called the Oxygen Catastrophe.
